AND v.period=?), selected AS (SELECT v.*,CASE WHEN v.close_period IS NOT NULL THEN 'close_manifest' ELSE 'current_publication' END AS selection_source,v.calculation_id AS voucher_calculation_id,CASE WHEN v.reverses_id IS NOT NULL THEN original.calculation_id WHEN (? OR v.close_period IS NULL) THEN coalesce(current_publication.calculation_id,v.calculation_id) ELSE v.calculation_id END AS basis_calculation_id FROM candidates v LEFT JOIN voucher_version original ON original.id=v.reverses_id LEFT JOIN calculation_current current_basis ON current_basis.subject_id=v.voucher_subject_id LEFT JOIN calculation_publication current_publication ON current_publication.calculation_id=current_basis.calculation_id AND current_publication.voucher_id=v.voucher_id AND current_publication.posting_period=v.period WHERE v.close_period IS NOT NULL OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_current a WHERE a.version_id=v.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM period_close p WHERE p.period=v.period))) SELECT s.*,c.subject_id AS basis_subject_id,c.kind AS basis_kind,c.fact_id AS basis_fact_id,c.period AS calculation_period,c.digest AS result_digest,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_version x WHERE x.calculation_id=s.voucher_calculation_id AND x.reverses_id IS NOT NULL) AS replacement FROM selected s JOIN calculation c ON c.id=s.basis_calculation_id) j WHERE 1=1 AND j.period=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_line l WHERE l.version_id=j.id AND l.account IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)))), events AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT j.period,j.id event_id,j.number,j.basis_calculation_id calculation_id,j.basis_kind kind,CASE WHEN j.reverses_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE -1 END sign,0 opening,c.outcome FROM journal j JOIN calculation c ON c.id=j.basis_calculation_id), effects AS (SELECT e.*,CAST(b.key AS INTEGER) effect_index,json_extract(b.value,'$.category') category,json_extract(b.value,'$.key') balance_key,json_extract(b.value,'$.amount') amount FROM events e,json_each(e.outcome,'$.balances') b WHERE json_extract(b.value,'$.category') IN ('bank','cash','platform','short_term_investment')), money AS (SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY event_id ORDER BY effect_index)-1 local_index FROM effects WHERE category IN ('bank','cash','platform') AND amount!=0),transfers AS (SELECT event_id,count(DISTINCT category||char(0)||balance_key)>1 AND sum(amount)=0 internal FROM money GROUP BY event_id) SELECT m.event_id,m.number,m.calculation_id,m.kind,m.sign,m.category,m.balance_key,m.sign*m.amount signed_amount,json_extract(m.outcome,'$.values.actual_date') actual_date,printf('%012d:%s:%06d',m.number,m.calculation_id,m.local_index) page_key,(m.kind IN ('funds_transfer','cash_bank_transfer','bank_platform_transfer') AND t.internal) internal_transfer FROM money m JOIN transfers t USING(event_id)) GROUP BY category,balance_key

WITH selected AS (WITH candidates AS (SELECT v.*,n.number,vc.subject_id AS voucher_subject_id,NULL AS close_period FROM voucher_version v CROSS JOIN voucher n ON n.id=v.voucher_id CROSS JOIN calculation vc ON vc.id=v.calculation_id WHERE v.period<=? AND v.period=?), selected AS (SELECT v.*,CASE WHEN v.close_period IS NOT NULL THEN 'close_manifest' ELSE 'current_publication' END AS selection_source,v.calculation_id AS voucher_calculation_id,CASE WHEN v.reverses_id IS NOT NULL THEN original.calculation_id WHEN (? OR v.close_period IS NULL) THEN coalesce(current_publication.calculation_id,v.calculation_id) ELSE v.calculation_id END AS basis_calculation_id FROM candidates v LEFT JOIN voucher_version original ON original.id=v.reverses_id LEFT JOIN calculation_current current_basis ON current_basis.subject_id=v.voucher_subject_id LEFT JOIN calculation_publication current_publication ON current_publication.calculation_id=current_basis.calculation_id AND current_publication.voucher_id=v.voucher_id AND current_publication.posting_period=v.period WHERE v.close_period IS NOT NULL OR (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_current a WHERE a.version_id=v.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM period_close p WHERE p.period=v.period))) SELECT s.*,c.subject_id AS basis_subject_id,c.kind AS basis_kind,c.fact_id AS basis_fact_id,c.period AS calculation_period,c.digest AS result_digest,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_version x WHERE x.calculation_id=s.voucher_calculation_id AND x.reverses_id IS NOT NULL) AS replacement FROM selected s JOIN calculation c ON c.id=s.basis_calculation_id) SELECT ?,v.period,v.id,l.line_no,v.voucher_calculation_id,v.basis_calculation_id,p.id,v.reverses_id,l.account,l.debit,l.credit,l.cashflow,c.kind,c.fact_id,c.period,c.subject_id,c.digest FROM selected v JOIN voucher_line l ON l.version_id=v.id JOIN calculation c ON c.id=v.basis_calculation_id LEFT JOIN calculation_publication p ON p.calculation_id=v.basis_calculation_id ORDER BY v.id,l.line_no

WITH source_rows AS MATERIALIZED (WITH journal AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT j.* FROM (WITH scoped_vouchers AS (SELECT value AS id FROM json_each(?)), candidates AS (SELECT v.*,n.number,vc.subject_id AS voucher_subject_id,NULL AS close_period FROM scoped_vouchers scoped CROSS JOIN voucher_version v ON v.id=scoped.id CROSS JOIN voucher n ON n.id=v.voucher_id CROSS JOIN calculation vc ON vc.id=v.calculation_id WHERE v.period<=? AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM voucher_line l WHERE l.version_id=j.id AND l.account IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)))), events AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT j.period,j.id event_id,j.number,j.basis_calculation_id calculation_id,j.basis_kind kind,CASE WHEN j.reverses_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE -1 END sign,0 opening,c.outcome FROM journal j JOIN calculation c ON c.id=j.basis_calculation_id), effects AS (SELECT e.*,CAST(b.key AS INTEGER) effect_index,json_extract(b.value,'$.category') category,json_extract(b.value,'$.key') balance_key,json_extract(b.value,'$.amount') amount FROM events e,json_each(e.outcome,'$.balances') b WHERE json_extract(b.value,'$.category') IN ('bank','cash','platform','short_term_investment')), money AS (SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY event_id ORDER BY effect_index)-1 local_index FROM effects WHERE category IN ('bank','cash','platform') AND amount!=0),transfers AS (SELECT event_id,count(DISTINCT category||char(0)||balance_key)>1 AND sum(amount)=0 internal FROM money GROUP BY event_id) SELECT m.event_id,m.number,m.calculation_id,m.kind,m.sign,m.category,m.balance_key,m.sign*m.amount signed_amount,json_extract(m.outcome,'$.values.actual_date') actual_date,printf('%012d:%s:%06d',m.number,m.calculation_id,m.local_index) page_key,(m.kind IN ('funds_transfer','cash_bank_transfer','bank_platform_transfer') AND t.internal) internal_transfer FROM money m JOIN transfers t USING(event_id)), filtered_rows AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM source_rows WHERE 1=1), page_rows AS (SELECT * FROM filtered_rows WHERE page_key>? ORDER BY page_key LIMIT ?) SELECT page_rows.*, counts.total_count, counts.filtered_count, counts.cursor_present FROM (SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM source_rows) total_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM filtered_rows) filtered_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM filtered_rows WHERE page_key=?) cursor_present) counts LEFT JOIN page_rows ON 1=1

SELECT f.id,f.digest,f.period,s.kind,c.voucher_version_id FROM json_each(?) ids LEFT JOIN fact_revision f ON f.id=ids.value LEFT JOIN subject s ON s.id=f.subject_id LEFT JOIN fact_report_classification c ON c.revision_id=f.id ORDER BY ids.value
SELECT id FROM voucher_version WHERE period>=? AND period<=? AND period NOT IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))

SELECT category,balance_key,sum(amount) FROM period_balance WHERE posting_period>? AND posting_period<=? AND category IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?)) GROUP BY category,balance_key ORDER BY category,balance_key

SELECT f.revision_id,json_object('amount_fen',f."amount_fen",'duplicate_location',f."duplicate_location",'duplicate_source_id',f."duplicate_source_id",'links',json(COALESCE((SELECT json_group_array(json_object('amount_fen',c."amount_fen",'amount_field',c."amount_field",'calculation_id',c."calculation_id",'fact_id',c."fact_id",'fact_kind',c."fact_kind",'recognition_period',CASE WHEN c."recognition_period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(c."recognition_period")='integer' AND c."recognition_period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', c."recognition_period"/12+1, c."recognition_period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END,'subject_id',c."subject_id") ORDER BY c.item_no) FROM fact_material_resolution_v2_links c WHERE c.revision_id=f.revision_id), '[]')),'location',f."location",'non_accounting_reason',f."non_accounting_reason",'period',CASE WHEN f."period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(f."period")='integer' AND f."period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', f."period"/12+1, f."period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END,'reason',f."reason",'recognition_period',CASE WHEN f."recognition_period" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CASE WHEN typeof(f."recognition_period")='integer' AND f."recognition_period" BETWEEN 0 AND 119987 THEN printf('%04d-%02d', f."recognition_period"/12+1, f."recognition_period"%12+1) ELSE 0 END END,'source_fact_id',f."source_fact_id",'source_id',f."source_id",'treatment',f."treatment") FROM json_each(?) ids CROSS JOIN fact_material_resolution_v2 f ON f.revision_id=ids.value

SELECT ids.value requested_subject_id,f.fact_id current_fact_id,c.id,c.fact_id,c.period,CASE WHEN json_type(c.outcome,'$.values')='object' THEN (SELECT json_group_object(j.key,json(c.outcome->j.fullkey)) FROM json_each(c.outcome,'$.values') j WHERE substr(j.key,-4)='_fen') ELSE json_extract(c.outcome,'$.values') END result_values FROM json_each(?) ids LEFT JOIN fact_current f ON f.subject_id=ids.value LEFT JOIN calculation_current a ON a.subject_id=f.subject_id LEFT JOIN calculation c ON c.id=a.calculation_id ORDER BY ids.value

WITH source_rows AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT printf('%s:%012d',json_extract(h.value,'$.subject_id'),e.item_no) page_key,json_extract(h.value,'$.account_id') account_id,json_extract(h.value,'$.reconciliation_calculation_id') reconciliation_calculation_id,m.source_kind,m.source_id,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY json_extract(h.value,'$.reconciliation_calculation_id'),m.source_kind,m.source_id) source_row_count,sum(abs(e.signed_fen)) OVER (PARTITION BY json_extract(h.value,'$.reconciliation_calculation_id'),m.source_kind,m.source_id) source_rows_total_fen,e.*,CASE WHEN json_extract(h.value,'$.valid') AND m.reference IS NOT NULL THEN 'matched' WHEN json_extract(h.value,'$.review') THEN 'needs_review' ELSE 'unmatched' END state FROM json_each(?) h JOIN fact_bank_statement_entries e ON e.revision_id=json_extract(h.value,'$.fact_id') LEFT JOIN fact_bank_reconciliation_matches m ON m.revision_id=json_extract(h.value,'$.reconciliation_id') AND m.reference=e.reference), filtered_rows AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM source_rows WHERE 1=1), page_rows AS (SELECT * FROM filtered_rows WHERE page_key>? SELECT account_id,count(*) transaction_count,coalesce(sum(max(signed_fen,0)),0) inflow_fen,coalesce(sum(max(-signed_fen,0)),0) outflow_fen,coalesce(sum(state='matched'),0) matched_count,coalesce(sum(state='unmatched'),0) unmatched_count,coalesce(sum(state='needs_review'),0) needs_review_count,max(actual_date) last_activity_date,coalesce(sum(state!='matched'),0) unmatched_total_count,coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN state!='matched' THEN max(signed_fen,0) ELSE 0 END),0) unmatched_inflow_fen,coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN state!='matched' THEN max(-signed_fen,0) ELSE 0 END),0) unmatched_outflow_fen FROM (SELECT printf('%s:%012d',json_extract(h.value,'$.subject_id'),e.item_no) page_key,json_extract(h.value,'$.account_id') account_id,json_extract(h.value,'$.reconciliation_calculation_id') reconciliation_calculation_id,m.source_kind,m.source_id,count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY json_extract(h.value,'$.reconciliation_calculation_id'),m.source_kind,m.source_id) source_row_count,sum(abs(e.signed_fen)) OVER (PARTITION BY json_extract(h.value,'$.reconciliation_calculation_id'),m.source_kind,m.source_id) source_rows_total_fen,e.*,CASE WHEN json_extract(h.value,'$.valid') AND m.reference IS NOT NULL THEN 'matched' WHEN json_extract(h.value,'$.review') THEN 'needs_review' ELSE 'unmatched' END state FROM json_each(?) h JOIN fact_bank_statement_entries e ON e.revision_id=json_extract(h.value,'$.fact_id') LEFT JOIN fact_bank_reconciliation_matches m ON m.revision_id=json_extract(h.value,'$.reconciliation_id') AND m.reference=e.reference) GROUP BY account_id

WITH requests AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]') AS slot,json_extract(value,'$[1]') AS kind,json_extract(value,'$[2]') AS key,json_extract(value,'$[3]') AS cutoff FROM json_each(?)), ids AS (SELECT q.slot,f.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN fact_revision f ON f.id=substr(q.key,2) CROSS JOIN subject s ON s.id=f.subject_id CROSS JOIN fact_seal z ON z.fact_id=f.id WHERE substr(q.key,1,1)='#' AND (q.kind='*' OR q.kind=s.kind) AND f.period<q.cutoff UNION ALL SELECT q.slot,f.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN subject s ON s.kind=q.kind CROSS JOIN fact_current a ON a.subject_id=s.id CROSS JOIN fact_revision f ON f.id=a.fact_id WHERE q.key='*' AND f.period<q.cutoff UNION ALL SELECT q.slot,f.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN fact_scope x ON x.kind=q.kind AND x.scope_key=q.key CROSS JOIN fact_current a ON a.fact_id=x.fact_id CROSS JOIN fact_revision f ON f.id=a.fact_id WHERE q.key<>'*' AND substr(q.key,1,1)<>'#' AND q.kind<>'*' AND f.period<q.cutoff UNION ALL SELECT q.slot,f.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN fact_scope x ON x.scope_key=q.key CROSS JOIN fact_current a ON a.fact_id=x.fact_id CROSS JOIN fact_revision f ON f.id=a.fact_id WHERE q.key<>'*' AND substr(q.key,1,1)<>'#' AND q.kind='*' AND f.period<q.cutoff) SELECT ids.slot,f.id,f.subject_id FROM ids CROSS JOIN fact_revision f ON f.id=ids.id ORDER BY ids.slot,f.subject_id

WITH requests AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT json_extract(value,'$[0]') AS slot,json_extract(value,'$[1]') AS kind,json_extract(value,'$[2]') AS key,json_extract(value,'$[3]') AS cutoff FROM json_each(?)), ids AS (SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=substr(q.key,2) CROSS JOIN calculation_seal z ON z.calculation_id=c.id WHERE substr(q.key,1,1)='#' AND (q.kind='*' OR q.kind=c.kind) AND c.period<q.cutoff UNION ALL SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.kind=q.kind CROSS JOIN calculation_current a ON a.calculation_id=c.id WHERE q.key='*' AND c.period<q.cutoff UNION ALL SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation_scope x ON x.kind=q.kind AND x.scope_key=q.key CROSS JOIN calculation_current a ON a.calculation_id=x.calculation_id CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=a.calculation_id WHERE q.key<>'*' AND substr(q.key,1,1)<>'#' AND q.kind<>'*' AND c.period<q.cutoff UNION ALL SELECT q.slot,c.id FROM requests q CROSS JOIN calculation_scope x ON x.scope_key=q.key CROSS JOIN calculation_current a ON a.calculation_id=x.calculation_id CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=a.calculation_id WHERE q.key<>'*' AND substr(q.key,1,1)<>'#' AND q.kind='*' AND c.period<q.cutoff) SELECT ids.slot,c.* FROM ids CROSS JOIN calculation c ON c.id=ids.id ORDER BY ids.slot,c.period,c.subject_id

ORDER BY s.posting_period,p.sequence,s.item_no
